paragraphs.text: Walker is a predefined token introduced in Secret Lair Drop Series: The Walking Dead .
A Walker is a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
Walkers are the only predefined token without a subtype matching its name and the only predefined creature token.

When initially released, "Walker tokens" were not defined in the rules text of the cards that created them nor were they defined in the Comprehensive Rules . This was rectified in the Kaldheim rules update.
